title: Reduction composition from limit composition by adjunction
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l in universe u. Let A be a PodReindexFamily l E [def-pod-completion-reindex-coherence]. Write L_W for (podReindexCalculus l E W).reduction, R_W for coefficientSequenceLimit l E W, F_f for podOrdinaryReindex l E f, and P_f for integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E f. Write alpha_f and beta_f for (A.completion f).reduction and .limit, kappa_(h,f) for A.compositionDerived l E h f, and sigma_(h,f) for integralComparisonSystemComposition l E h f [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. Assume PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E f (A.completion f) for every scheme isomorphism between schemes on which l is invertible [def-pod-completion-reindex-models]. Assume for every composable pair h:Z→W, f:W→V of such isomorphisms and every N in coefficientSequenceDerived l E V the whole-system limit equation kappa_(h,f)(R_V N) ≫ F_h(beta_f(N)) ≫ beta_h(P_f N) = beta_(h≫f)(N) ≫ R_Z(sigma_(h,f)(N)). Then for every such pair and every ambient K in DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E V), sigma_(h,f)(L_V K) ≫ P_h(alpha_f(K)) ≫ alpha_h(F_f K) = alpha_(h≫f)(K) ≫ L_Z(kappa_(h,f)(K)). No section-normalization or tensor law is needed in addition to the stated limit equation.

proof.text: Apply the inverse-unit formula: the transpose of alpha_f inverse under the target adjunction is F_f(unit_V) followed by beta_f. It follows by composing the given Unit equation with R_W(alpha_f inverse) and cancelling alpha_f followed by its inverse.

Transpose the two inverse reduction paths using the Z adjunction Hom equivalence. Naturality of beta_h moves P_h(alpha_f inverse) across beta_h. The f inverse-unit formula combines the two unit factors. Substitute the assumed limit equation, cancel sigma with its inverse, and use naturality of kappa inverse. Apply the composite inverse-unit formula and naturality of the Z unit. Injectivity of the Hom equivalence identifies inverse paths; Iso.ext on their symmetric isomorphisms gives the forward equation.

theorem podReindexingCompositionReduction
    (A : PodReindexFamily l E)
    (hcompletion : ∀ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)],
      PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E f (A.completion f))
    (hlimit :
    ∀ {V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ W) (f : W ⟶ V) [IsIso h] [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
      [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)],
      ∀ N : coefficientSequenceDerived l E V,
        (A.compositionDerived l E h f).hom.app ((coefficientSequenceLimit l E V).obj N) ≫
          (podOrdinaryReindex l E h).map ((A.completion f).limit.hom.app N) ≫
          (A.completion h).limit.hom.app ((integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E f).obj N) =
        (A.completion (h ≫ f)).limit.hom.app N ≫
          (coefficientSequenceLimit l E Z).map
            ((integralComparisonSystemComposition l E h f).hom.app N)) :
    ∀ {V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ W) (f : W ⟶ V) [IsIso h] [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
      [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)],
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E V),
        (integralComparisonSystemComposition l E h f).hom.app
            ((podReindexCalculus l E V).reduction.obj K) ≫
          (integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E h).map
            ((A.completion f).reduction.hom.app K) ≫
          (A.completion h).reduction.hom.app ((podOrdinaryReindex l E f).obj K) =
        (A.completion (h ≫ f)).reduction.hom.app K ≫
          (podReindexCalculus l E Z).reduction.map
            ((A.compositionDerived l E h f).hom.app K)
